name: busy-office
description: Busy Office skills for Claude Code. busy-office-mode routes a multi-step task to one of twelve playbooks (feature, bug fix, investigation, refactor, goal run, loop tick, grill, landing, plugin release, session pickup, pause, figure it out). Playbooks call tool skills: how, why, review, deploy-agents, improve-until-done, correct, blast-radius, solo-flow, progress-dashboard, jev (a typed second opinion from jev-ai.pro; the API key is asked for at install) and automate-me (run by the user only). The loop family reviews a scheduled autonomous loop: loop-doctor, loop-economist, loop-atlas, wake-weight, requeue, sharpen-intent, graph-engineer. Ten principle skills hold each shared rule once. Read-only collectors with fixtures, a drift check, and reports graded by a blind critic.

api_key.title: jev-ai.pro API key
api_key.description: For the jev skill. Create one at jev-ai.pro → API Keys. Leave empty to skip; set it later with /plugin configure busy-office.

add_to_path.title: Add jev to your Terminal
add_to_path.description: For the jev skill: link ~/.local/bin/jev to this plugin so plain `jev` works in a Terminal, kept pointing at the current version after updates. Never replaces a file it didn't make.

allow_all_repos.title: Allow all repos to send to Jev
allow_all_repos.description: For the jev skill: let every repo on this machine send to jev-ai.pro, except repos you block with `jev deny` — the same as `jev allow --all`. Off: allow repos one by one with `jev allow` in a Terminal.
